about: Second Higgsfield brief for YCT 1 (2026-10-12, his note: 'some questions don't have the pictures available, YCT1'): 8 word pictures that were missing + 26 scene pictures for the sentence questions of the 6 worlds. Same style / dralingo / cast templates as yct1-pictures.json. Originals -> assets-library/higgsfield/2026-10-12/yct1b/<world>/<slug>.png; web copy -> public/assets/packs/yct1/<world>/<slug>.webp (720 px, WebP q82). Time words (hoy, mañana, mes, semana, ahora, la hora, día del mes) and sentences with clock times, dates or ages stay text-only on purpose (a clock or calendar needs digits). 'ser / es' is too abstract to draw.
